name: Oceanic Foods Limited
about: Oceanic Foods Limited engages in the production, processing, and sale of dehydrated vegetables and herbs in India and internationally. The company provides dehydrated onion, garlic, and vegetables; and other products, such as black salt powder, non-iodised and iodised fine salt, and raw salt. The company also offers dehydrated onion flakes, kibbled, minced, chopped, granules, and powder; dehydrated garlic flakes, food preservation, cold storage services, and trading of coal. It also exports its products. Oceanic Foods Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Jamnagar, India.
